rule: Never rotate/bob the whole beacon to fake tracking. Base stays planted; head aims around measured pan/tilt pivots; lamp is state-only.

semantic_triggers.approach_started: head acquires rocket and begins measured tracking
semantic_triggers.approach_state_changed: lamp pattern/state changes safe/unsafe without baked beam
semantic_triggers.touchdown: short physical/state confirmation then return toward neutral

pivot_policy: pan/tilt coordinates remain null until processed isolated head/base art is measured
